title: Introduce manifest preflight validator and autorelease stager for model intake
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce a preflight manifest validator that checks required metadata, perf-profile thresholds, and hardware affinity hints before model acceptance.
Add an autorelease stager that composes concise changelog bullets from the manifest delta and enqueues release drafts for curator review.
CLI hook: `rmcli model preflight` and an API endpoint for automated CI gates.
Backwards compatible: validation is opt-in for existing ingestion pipelines; default remains permissive until rollout.
Added unit and integration tests and docs for the new onboarding flow.
description: Summary: Adds a manifest preflight validator and an autorelease stager to the model intake path. Motivation: onboarding errors and noisy release notes are a recurring source of manual work for curation and SRE. This change aims to (1) surface manifest inconsistencies and performance-profile regressions earlier in CI; (2) normalise and auto-generate release note fragments so curators can approve faster; (3) provide a clear opt-in rollout path so existing pipelines are not broken. What this does: The change introduces `registry/onboard/preflight.py` which runs a thorough validation pass over incoming model manifests (schema conformance, required provenance, runtime-affinity hints, and perf-profile sanity checks). A new `registry/release/autorelease/handler.py` component diffs the incoming manifest against the latest registered version and synthesizes an ordered list of release note bullets (performance deltas, new aliases, deprecations, changelog teasers). The CLI exposes `rmcli model preflight --manifest <file>` to run the same checks locally, and `rmcli model stage-release --model-id <id>` to enqueue an autorelease draft. Backwards compatibility: preflight is disabled by default for existing intake jobs; the new intake pipeline can opt-in via `ONBOARD_PREFLIGHT=true` in environment. Tests and docs: unit tests added under `tests/test_preflight.py` and developer facing documentation in `docs/processes/onboard-preflight.md`. Commits: 1) "add preflight validator and canonical manifest schema v2" — implements schema checks, validation helpers and unit tests. 2) "add autorelease stager and changelog synthesizer" — adds delta logic, simple prose templates, and integration hook. 3) "cli and docs: expose preflight and stage-release commands" — CLI wiring and docs. Files changed (high level): - registry/onboard/preflight.py (new) - registry/onboard/schema/manifest_v2.yaml (new) - registry/release/autorelease/handler.py (new) - cli/rmcli/commands/onboard.py (update) - tests/test_preflight.py (new) - docs/processes/onboard-preflight.md (new) - registry/release/autorelease/templates/brief_snippets.tmpl (new) Small illustrative diffs: preflight.py includes a `validate_perf_profile()` routine that checks latency P95 and token-cost heuristics against model-class baselines; handler.py contains a `synthesize_release_bullets(prev, next)` that emits prioritized bullets and severity tags. Review thread (high level): - Priya Nair (review): "This looks solid — main concern is the perf threshold defaults. Can we make the P95 thresholds driven by a workload profile instead of global constants? Also add a unit test for a manifest with multiple variant aliases." - Maya Chen (author reply): "Agree — switched to workload-driven thresholds. Added `workload_profiles.yaml` and a test `test_preflight_workload_thresholds`." - Ethan Rivera (requested changes): "Please add an explicit opt-in flag for autorelease drafts; we don't want autorelease to auto-queue drafts for large enterprise customers without curator consent." - Maya Chen: "Added `autorelease.mode` in manifest schema (values: off|draft|auto). Default is 'off'. Updated docs and CLI to require `--force-autorelease` for automatic staging." - Luca Bianchi (approval): "Approvals from security and infra side; small nits in logging noted but non-blocking." CI notes: initial run showed an intermittent integration flake in `integration-onboard` (timeout on a mocked network call). Flake reproduced locally, fixed by increasing the test harness network stub timeout and retry logic; CI re-run green. Performance considerations: validation is designed to be cheap (schema checks + sampling of perf deltas); heavy perf regression checks are throttled via the intake config and are only executed in dedicated CI gating runs. Rollout plan: start with canary on the 'staging-intake' workflow for two weeks, then opt-in to 'production-intake' for teams that enable ONBOARD_PREFLIGHT. Autorelease mode will be set to 'draft' by default for the first month so curated reviewers see generated snippets but must approve prior to publication. Related work: references ENG-4321 for perf-profile rationalisation and ENG-5632 for curator UX improvements. Merge outcome: squash-merged to main on 2026-02-21 after approvals from Priya and Luca and green CI. Post-merge tasks: - Add a small dashboard card in Console to show preflight pass-rate per team (follow-up PR). - Add an automated smoke check that ensures `autorelease.mode` never defaults to 'auto' for orgs with enterprise policy. Contact: Maya Chen (@mchen) for follow-ups or rollback requests.
